original_test_intent: Establish the exact SUT's physical COM console path with correct wiring and serial settings and verify a trusted terminal session produces the expected prompt and benign command output.
original_method: A trained operator identifies and connects the specified physical COM port/cable/adapter, configures documented baud/parity/data/stop/flow settings, captures target identity/prompt, sends an approved non-destructive command and verifies exact output while preserving photos/session/logs.
manual_activity: A trained operator physically connects the correct COM path, verifies pinout/electrical/terminal settings, owns the live session and confirms exact prompt/output; the owner adjudicates results.
required_inputs: Exact SUT serial and physical COM connector/location/pinout/electrical level
Baud, data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control, encoding and line-ending profile
Expected console owner, boot/runtime prompt and benign command/output contract
Photo/capture/redaction policy and independent recovery path
safety_requirements: Verify SUT/port/pinout/electrical level before connection; do not guess wiring
Preserve logs and console baseline rather than clearing evidence
Ensure no concurrent console owner and use only an approved benign read-only command
Stop on garbling, wrong prompt/SUT, electrical/adapter fault, unexpected privilege or command behavior
Close/release the session safely and never substitute SOL configuration for physical-path proof
agent_execution_scope: After the operator establishes the path, assist with timestamped capture/redaction and expected-output comparison
Optionally collect read-only SOL/host identity only when the owner maps it to supporting context
Verify evidence completeness and separate variant identity
Perform no physical wiring, terminal ownership action or unapproved console command
engineer_actions: Provide port/pinout/serial settings and benign expected command/output
Supervise physical connection/session and resolve any console ownership or garbling issue
Review photos/capture/logs and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool sol info can describe SOL settings but does not establish a physical COM connection. NVIDIA PCIe qualification, 10000x Tx equalization, lspci and link-stress content are entirely inapplicable to this variant.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator uses the approved terminal client on the verified physical COM adapter and records one benign command/output exchange; automation may validate the saved transcript after connection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical COM setup, correct terminal output and 5/5-minute estimates remain; serial parameters are project inputs rather than guessed defaults.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH MANUAL PHYSICAL COM CONSOLE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a connection checklist binding photos of labeled endpoints, adapter/pinout/settings, console banner/serial identity and a benign challenge-response transcript, then close/release ownership and hash artifacts.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target/electrical/serial-parameter and ownership evidence while removing unrelated PCIe material and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A configured SOL channel or responsive terminal window cannot prove the specified physical COM wiring or correct SUT output; physical endpoint and transcript must agree.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect pinout/electrical level can damage hardware; a live console may have privileged control. Both require a trained operator and constrained commands.

project_override_considerations: If the platform formally implements the named COM path through an approved console server, the owner must map its physical port/cabling to the SUT; remote SOL alone is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and explicit separation from same-code PCIe/Thermal rows
Photos of labeled physical path and timestamped initial banner/prompt
Approved benign command, exact expected versus observed output/echo/line-ending comparison
Preserved pre/post logs, session close/ownership release and operator/owner verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is a physical COM Console Test, while source AI package/log/risk fields describe NVIDIA PCIe qualification, 10000x Tx-eq redo and link stress. Those copied fields belong to a different test and are explicitly excluded under Master authority.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Physical access and project serial parameters are execution prerequisites; they do not block completion of the static engineering review.

review_improvement: Restores the physical COM functional objective, isolates same-code variants and defines evidence that distinguishes correct wiring/output from a merely configured SOL channel.
independent_technical_reasoning: The essential property is end-to-end physical path correctness: connector/pinout/electrical adapter, serial framing, target identity and terminal data must all align. Software can parse a transcript but cannot establish or inspect the cable. SOL may traverse a different BMC multiplexed path and therefore supplies only supporting evidence unless formally mapped. Because the console may provide privileged commands, the challenge must be benign and predetermined; output correctness should include prompt/echo/encoding rather than subjective readability.
